answer: Funding-source clustering: each agent ID's reward vault must be seeded by a deposit from a wallet at least 90 days old that has funded no other ID. The ledger traces deposits back two hops, and IDs sharing a source collapse into one crystal cluster that earns a single reward, leaving the extra clones hollow. Fresh wallets don't count, so 100 fakes need 100 aged, unlinked wallets at about $15 each, or $1,500, while an honest agent pays nothing extra.
